structured_output.summary:
Second-floor hall (top landing) is furnished in parts/room-8.mjs: a two-high bookshelf wall in the NW/E corner with a barrel and flower pot, a red carpet rug, and two hanging lanterns under the loft floor.
The stair-arrival, corridor-door and bath-door lanes are kept clear, and the well and its rail are left to the stair joiner.
make.sh saves a whole build.nbt; room check says OK, min light 8 at every foot cell, 0 dark; the room render reads correctly from above.
left: Walker lists 5 bookshelf-top cells (y21, z7..10) as unreachable: they are the tops of the stacked shelves, not floor, so this is harmless; the stair well x5..6 z12..16 is a hole by design.
Orphan blocks outside my part, reported by mcd check: smooth_stone_slab at 16,5,7 (pavement/shell), spruce_slab at 5,23,3 and 5,23,24 (grounds/shell). Not mine to fix.
plan.md and elements.md have no room-level tick or item for the interior parts, so I left them unchanged.
